profile.headline: Senior Director, Product Management | Product Strategy, Audience Growth & Monetization @ FOX
profile.summary:
Senior Director of Product Management leading product strategy across Fox's digital platforms. I build scalable products, manage cross-functional teams, and connect technology to measurable business outcomes. Over two decades at Fox, I've evolved from hands-on builder to product leader, shaping initiatives that power personalization, identity, and engagement across web, mobile, and CTV.

Today I focus on audience growth, retention, and monetization, and on the space between teams where good work ships in parallel without anyone asking how it fits together. I connect those dots, surface the tradeoffs early, and help the business make the call.

positions.title: Director, Technical Products
positions.description:
Lead technical product strategy and delivery across Fox News Media platforms, driving scalable systems, identity solutions, and cross-functional alignment.
• Led the 1st Party Data initiative to prepare for third-party cookie deprecation, identifying millions of users and improving data quality and ad addressability
• Drove content gating and identity strategies that increased logins and supported long-term audience growth
• Scaled Braze across Fox platforms, streamlining marketing operations and replacing legacy tools (Airship, SFMC, Redfast)
• Implemented Heap and Amplitude for stronger analytics and faster KPI tracking
• Built and lead the Product Owner team responsible for backlog health, sprint delivery, and release execution
• Partnered with Legal, Engineering, and CRM to ensure compliant data collection and messaging across systems
positions.insights: Platform product management, Technical Leadership and +6 skills

positions.title: Director, Digital Marketing & Creative
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
Directed digital marketing and creative production across Fox News Media properties, leading acquisition and engagement initiatives through immersive, tech-forward campaign experiences.

• Launched a custom marketing tech stack supporting major show campaigns, promotions, and seasonal activations (Black Friday, Easter, etc.)
• Led creative and technical execution across digital ads, videos, emails, and landing pages to maximize engagement and conversion
• Built Fox’s first Books website for the Fox News Books publishing partnership
• Managed in-house and agency teams delivering on-brand assets across multiple channels
• Partnered with Product and CRM to align creative strategy with platform capabilities and audience insights
This role laid the groundwork for my transition into product leadership, where I shifted focus from creative and marketing execution to building scalable technical platforms and cross-functional systems.
positions.insights: Roadmapping and prioritization and Creative Strategy

positions.title: Senior Web Developer, Product Manager
positions.description: Built and maintained websites, applications, and social platforms for Fox News Channel's New Media group. Split time between hands-on development and product management, gathering requirements from editorial and business teams and shipping the work myself.
